# learning_episode

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Compiles one exact-subject execution episode into bounded learning evidence without granting actuation authority.

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `episode_id` | `string` | yes | Stable learning episode identity. |
| `exact_subject_sha` | `string` | yes | Exact Git subject observed by the episode. |
| `evidence_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest binding the episode to immutable evidence. |
| `outcome` | `string` | yes | Observed success, refusal, or failure outcome. |
| `authority_ceiling` | `string` | yes | Maximum authority learning may influence; DO authority remains excluded. |
